sources.publisher: Genera PR LLC, filed with the Puerto Rico Energy Bureau (PREB)
sources.filing_title: Motion to Request Comments on Genera’s Preliminary Response to the June 30, 2023 Order
supports: Comment 3: PREB asked Genera to 'detail Genera's plan for managing obsolete spare parts in the short, medium, and long term, and outline steps that will be taken to obtain needed parts that are obsolete or no longer available'. The response describes an inventory audit and write-off of obsolete stock; it does not describe how parts no longer available would be obtained.

Comment 7: PREB noted 'many parts' with quantity in stock and required quantity both zero and asked whether they were eliminated, substituted or declared obsolete; the response refers back to comment 3.
Comment 14: Genera validated quantities by random counts over three months against the PREPA inventory listing.
sources.quality_note: 20 comment/response rows; all read.

sources.publisher: Genera PR LLC, filed with the Puerto Rico Energy Bureau (PREB)
sources.filing_title: Motion to Submit Genera PR LLC’s June 13 Recommendation Letter in Compliance with the June 16 Order
supports: Eight plant sheets list parts with plant, unit, major equipment, equipment OEM, equipment model, system, part name, description, part manufacturer, OEM part number, alternate suppliers, PREPA/Genera part number, classification, importance and stock quantities.
Analyst count of part rows: 12,409 (San Juan CC 844, San Juan Steam 4,720, Aguirre Steam 538, Aguirre CC 1,695, Costa Sur Steam 1,764, Cambalache GT 350, Palo Seco Steam 1,295, Peakers GT 1,203).
'Summary Totals' sheet: 12,319 line items; 4,269 with insufficient stock; total cost of parts to be ordered $94,107,784.86.
OEM part number populated on 3,283 of 12,409 rows; part manufacturer on 112; 'Alternate Suppliers (A, B, C)' on none.
660 rows have quantity on hand and quantity intended both zero; 19 rows contain the words obsolete / obsoleto / discontinued / no longer in the description.
sources.quality_note: Counts are the analyst's, by column position after the header row; rows were not read individually. The 90-row difference from the workbook's own summary is unexplained. Dated June 2023; later inventories may differ.

Estimated delivery dates run to 2026; many items are 'TBD - Under RFP'.
